# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.12.1

**A fix for Master Evolved.** This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## Fixed

- **Master Evolved started as normal Evolved**, with its usual lives, when the game showed Evolved's intro screen between the tile and the round. A Master tile now holds its choice until the round starts, whichever screens come in between. Master Deadline was not affected.

Runs played as normal Evolved this way counted as normal Evolved runs, exactly as if picked from the first page. Everything from v0.12.0 is still here: online replays of every board's top 50, Watch Replay on the leaderboard screen, and the Master modes.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.12.1-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
